title: Juicy Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: Savory and slightly sweet lamb skewers, marinated in a mixture of yogurt and spices, then grilled to perfection. A crowd-pleaser that's easy to make and transportable for picnics or potlucks.

ingredients.name: Peach juice
ingredients.notes: Adds sweetness and moisture to lamb

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine yogurt, sugar, peach juice, kimchi, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
Transfer the marinade to a large bowl and add the lamb cubes. Mix well to coat the lamb evenly.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat. Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with coconut oil to prevent sticking. Grill the lamb skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the lamb skewers to a serving platter and garnish with parsley. Serve immediately.
Let the lamb rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with additional marinade sauce on the side, if desired.
